author: iWst
content: Two more bugs found running the live UI: (1) Globe.tsx had a stray <sphereGeometry args={[0.99, 32, 32]} /> child of <points> that overwrote the constructed icosphere geometry — removed. (2) ControlPanel had no Run Simulation button anywhere — added a prominent green button at top-left that walks the worker through Tectonics → Erosion → Hydrology → Climate (GCM) → Biomes → Civilization with status updates per stage, then refreshes the snapshot to populate Globe with elevation/plate/temperature/precipitation/wind/biome/settlement/etc. Extended InitState to hold all sim outputs so Globe layer toggles work. 461/461 tests still pass, tsc clean.
